evidence.title: Competitor Phase 3 programme in obesity: cagrilintide
evidence.text: Competitor program in obesity: cagrilintide has 6 registered Phase 3 trial(s) in obesity that are active or planned. Lead sponsor(s): Novo Nordisk A/S. Planned enrollment across these trials: 5175 participants. Statuses: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING 4, RECRUITING 2. Earliest planned primary completion 2024-10-30, latest 2030-03-20. Trials: NCT05567796, NCT06780449, NCT07220642, NCT07220759, NCT07253285, NCT07745504. This is a registry snapshot of trial activity. A registered trial is not evidence that the drug works.

evidence.title: Competitor Phase 3 programme in obesity: eloralintide
evidence.text: Competitor program in obesity: eloralintide has 5 registered Phase 3 trial(s) in obesity that are active or planned. Lead sponsor(s): Eli Lilly and Company. Planned enrollment across these trials: 5615 participants. Statuses: RECRUITING 5. Earliest planned primary completion 2028-01, latest 2028-06. Trials: NCT07282600, NCT07321886, NCT07353931, NCT07369011, NCT07392190. This is a registry snapshot of trial activity. A registered trial is not evidence that the drug works.
